name: Irimu (Leopard Form)
body:
IRIMU (LEOPARD FORM)
CR 3

XP 800
N Medium humanoid (human, irimu, shapechanger)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)
hp 30 (4d8+12)
Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +2
DR 5/silver

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +6 (1d6+3 plus grab), 2 claws +6 (1d3+3)
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +6, 1d3+3)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +6 (+10 grapple); CMD 20 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Cunningvc, Dodge, Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Acrobatics +7 (+11 when jumping), Climb +11, Handle Animal +8, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +5, Stealth +10 (+14 in undergrowth), Survival +5; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Stealth in undergrowth
Languages Common (can’t speak)
SQ accursed skinchanger, catlike jump, change shape (human, leopard; polymorph), feline empathy

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Accursed Skinchanger (Su)

On the nights of the new moon, an irimu automatically transforms into leopard form and cannot revert to humanoid form until dawn. It becomes very aggressive, gaining a +2 morale bonus on Will saves and has at best an attitude of unfriendly, even toward those it normally considers friends. When the sun rises, the irimu returns to humanoid form and is fatigued for 2d4 hours. A remove curse spell returns an irimu to humanoid form for 7 days, during which it cannot use change shape. After that, the ability to change shape returns, but on the next new moon the curse attempts to re-exert itself. The irimu must succeed on a DC 15 Fort save each night of the new moon or involuntarily change into leopard form as described above. The save DC increases by +1 every night of the new moon thereafter until the irimu succumbs. An irimu’s curse can be permanently removed with miracle or wish.

Catlike Jump (Ex)

In leopard form, an irimu always counts as having a running start when making jump checks using Acrobatics.

Feline Empathy (Su)

Irimus can communicate and empathize with felines. They can use Diplomacy or Handle Animal to alter a feline’s attitude, and gain a +4 racial bonus on this check.

ECOLOGY

Irimu are shapeshifters afflicted by an ancient curse. They were once ordinary humans who venerated the spirit of the leopard and wore their skins in sacred rituals, building an affinity with these swift and stealthy predators. They learned the language of the great cats and even tamed them after a fashion, becoming hunting partners and sharing in the kill, becoming almost spiritbrothers to them. Their mystic connection drew the interest of ancient sorcerers who sought to bind the irimu to their service, and through their arts they corrupted the mystic rites so that the irimu did not just wear the pelts of fallen leopards but truly changed their flesh and walked as great hunting cats that scarcely remembered their humanity.
